name: Overnight Oats
why: Breakfast for the whole week with zero heat and zero pans. The fastest dent in the oat pile.

steps.text: Line up 4 cups or glasses on the counter.
Into each one put 60 g of oats, about three quarters of a cup.
Add 170 g Greek yogurt, 120 ml milk, 1 scoop of whey, 1 tsp cocoa and 1 tsp honey to each.

steps.look: Scrape right down to the bottom. Dry oats hiding underneath will still be dry and crunchy in the morning. It should look like thick porridge batter, and it thickens considerably overnight.
steps.warn: Whey powder clumps if you just tip it on top and stir once. Break up any lumps against the side of the cup with the back of the spoon.

steps.text: Drop a small handful of frozen berries on top of each.
steps.look: Straight from the freezer. They thaw overnight in the fridge and bleed a little colour into the top, which is the point.

steps.text: Cover them and put them in the fridge. Eat cold, straight from the cup, any time in the next 4 days.
